blocks.h2: Is It a Drain Clog or a Sewer Clog?
blocks.body: Start by counting the slow drains. If it's just one sink or tub, the clog is close to that fixture, and a cable clears it. If the basement floor drain fills when the washer empties, a toilet gurgles when the shower runs or every drain in the house is slow, the blockage is in the main sewer line. That's a job for [sewer rodding](/elmhurst/sewer-rodding) or [hydro jetting](/elmhurst/hydro-jetting). Either way, call when a plunger doesn't fix it or the same drain clogs again within weeks.

img.alt: Illustration of common signs a drain needs professional cleaning

bodies: Hair and soap scum in bathrooms, grease and food in the kitchen and lint in the laundry cause most household clogs. We clear them with a cable sized to the pipe and show you what we pulled out.

In Elmhurst homes built from the 1940s to the 1960s, original galvanized and cast iron drains are often still in the walls. They narrow with rust and scale, so clogs come back faster. When one drain keeps clogging, a camera look tells us whether it's buildup or failing pipe.
Grease is the main cause of kitchen clogs. It hardens on the pipe walls and traps food and soap.

When both bowls fill or the dishwasher drains into the sink, the clog is beyond the trap. We clear the line to the stack. If the disposal is involved, see [garbage disposal repair](/elmhurst/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).

blocks.h2: Why Drains Clog in Elmhurst Homes
blocks.intro: Elmhurst's housing mix shapes its drain problems.

items.h3: Original Drain Pipe in Postwar Homes
items.body: Old galvanized and cast iron catch debris.
New cabinets, original drain behind them.
Several slow drains at once mean the main. See [sewer drain clearing](#sewer-drain-clearing).

bodies: When the basement floor drain backs up or every fixture slows down, the main sewer drain is blocked. It takes a machine that can reach from the cleanout to the city main.

We clear the line and scope it so you see the cause. In Elmhurst, it's usually roots in clay or scale in cast iron. Repeat clogs get a plan: yearly [sewer rodding](/elmhurst/sewer-rodding), [hydro jetting](/elmhurst/hydro-jetting) or a [sewer repair](/elmhurst/sewer-repair).

blocks.h2: Drain Cleaning Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.preview: Clearing the main line to the city sewer.
items.answer: It's clearing the main line that carries everything from your house to the city sewer, usually with a rodding machine or a hydro jet.

items.q: Do you offer same-night drain cleaning?
items.answer: Yes. Call any time, and we'll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: Why do my drains clog more than my neighbor's?
items.answer: Pipe age, the layout of your drains and what goes down them all play a part. A camera look explains it.

items.preview: We'd avoid them on older pipe.
items.answer: We'd avoid them, especially on older pipe. They rarely clear the whole clog.

items.q: Can you clear a basement floor drain that smells?
items.answer: Yes. Often the trap is dry or partly clogged. We clear it and refill the trap.

items.q: How much does drain cleaning cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on where the clog is. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the clog is and what's causing it. You'll approve a flat price before we start.
